scientific_conclusion: The direct series/continued-fraction CDF plus bisection inverse is deterministic, failure-atomic and nearly cross-compiler exact, but it loses sufficient probability resolution around shape 100000. This produces a 0.001668 density error and repeated quantiles in all six high-shape groups, failing accuracy and strict monotonicity. More bisection iterations cannot recover information absent from the CDF evaluation.
next_leaf: Use a separately frozen high-shape asymptotic quantile branch while retaining the direct CDF inverse for low and moderate shape; evaluate the same full parameter grid without changing P4HO gates.
claim_ceiling: Negative portable inverse-Gamma density arithmetic result on synthetic parameter coverage; not complete grain structure, photographic parity, calibrated emulsion response, media integration or product promotion.
